# PageLabel

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Defines how the PDF viewer labels pages in its page counter, "go to page" dialog, and bookmark targets. Written as `/PageLabels` in the document catalog (PDF §12.4.2).

Setting `PageLabel` applies the labelling from the first page of the document.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new PageLabel()
```

## Properties

- [`Prefix`](#prefix): Optional label prefix prepended to every page label (e.g. `"A-"` → A-1, A-2, …).
- [`StartAt`](#startat): First value in the sequence.
- [`Style`](#style): Numbering style.

### `Prefix`

```csharp
string Prefix { get; set; }
```

Optional label prefix prepended to every page label (e.g. `"A-"` → A-1, A-2, …).

### `StartAt`

```csharp
int StartAt { get; set; }
```

First value in the sequence. Defaults to `1`.

### `Style`

```csharp
PageLabelStyle Style { get; set; }
```

Numbering style. Defaults to `Decimal`.
